snippet.title: Aurora's Awakening trailer
snippet.description:
Aurora's Awakening trailer released on may 29 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4092730/Auroras_Awakening/


Get ready for flashy, fast‑paced character action focused combat, directing Ever's Elemental powers to join you in every fight. Choose your team wisely—each Elemental can be leveled up to become stronger or to assist you with magical attacks. Ever herself gains new abilities as you progress, letting you customize her magic to match your play style. Casting fire, lightning, wind, and more.
